title: build: enable safe CA search by default (Windows)
body:
Previous default was to search for a CA bundle (`curl-ca-bundle.crt`) in 
a list of directories, including CWD and `PATH`, which allowed an
attacker to place a CA bundle there and the curl tool picking it up.
(Unless Native CA was enabled at  build time, which disables on-disk CA
bundle searches by default.)

Change the default to search for a CA bundle in the curl tool directory
only.

Note: This is a breaking change for curl builds using a non-Schannel TLS
backend, with Native CA and embedded CA disabled and with a
`curl-ca-bundle.crt` CA bundle file missing from the directory of 
`curl.exe`. To remedy, copy or download a valid CA bundle into the
`curl.exe` directory.

To keep old (insecure) behavior, build curl with:
- autotools: `--disable-ca-search-safe`
- cmake: `-DCURL_CA_SEARCH_SAFE=OFF`

Safe alternatives are Native CA, embedded CA, or Schannel if the
use-case allows.

Also:
- make sure to disable safe search option by default if native CA is
  enabled. To keep existing behavior.
- drop the option to enable safe search for Windows UWP builds.
  To keep existing behavior of not doing on-disk search, and to 
  simplify.
- remove disable-CA-search option for UWP builds. It's a no op,
  (unsafe) search is not supported on UWP because the necessary Win32
  API (`SearchPath()`) is not provided by the OS.

Reported-by: Joshua Rogers
Follow-up to 22652a5a4cb6a4cc1c0f4ff3ebc4f9768f6663cd #14582

---

https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/23277/files?w=1

curl-for-win has been shipping with CA bundle embedded since 8.10.0
(2024-09-11). It first did an unsafe search, and if not found a CA
bundle fell back to the embedded one. Since 8.19.0 (2026-03-11)
curl-for-win ships with Native CA and on-disk CA search disabled.
It also had safe CA search enabled in daily builds since 8.10.0-dev.

- [x] maybe add Unicode support to `tool_execpath()`? or keep disabled
  in Unicode builds (which would be a shame IMO).
- [x] perhaps break out the `tool_execpath()` patch into a separate PR. → #23287
- [x] rebase on #23287.
- [x] maybe keep safe search disabled for UWP, where the pre-existing
  behavior was: no search (because the necessary Win32 API is
  not available for UWP). Kind of corner or corner case, there seems
  to be almost (?) nobody using UWP, and especially nobody using
  the curl tool in UWP mode.

files.patch:
@@ -1406,8 +1406,10 @@ endif()
 option(CURL_CA_NATIVE "Use native CA store" OFF)
 if(CURL_CA_NATIVE)
   set(_curl_disable_ca_search_default ON)
+  set(_curl_ca_search_safe_default OFF)
 else()
   set(_curl_disable_ca_search_default OFF)
+  set(_curl_ca_search_safe_default ON)
 endif()
 
 if(_curl_ca_bundle_supported)
@@ -1502,9 +1504,10 @@ if(_curl_ca_bundle_supported)
   endif()
 endif()
 
-if(WIN32)
+if(WIN32 AND NOT WINDOWS_STORE)
   option(CURL_DISABLE_CA_SEARCH "Disable unsafe CA bundle search in PATH on Windows" ${_curl_disable_ca_search_default})
-  option(CURL_CA_SEARCH_SAFE "Enable safe CA bundle search (within the curl tool directory) on Windows" OFF)
+  option(CURL_CA_SEARCH_SAFE "Enable safe CA bundle search (within the curl tool directory) on Windows"
+         ${_curl_ca_search_safe_default})
 endif()
 
 set(CURL_INCLUDES "")

@@ -2212,7 +2212,8 @@ dnl ----------------------
 dnl check unsafe CA search
 dnl ----------------------
 
-if test "$curl_cv_native_windows" = "yes"; then
+dnl this is only used when safe CA search is disabled
+if test "$curl_cv_native_windows" = "yes" && test "$curl_cv_winuwp" != "yes"; then
   ca_search=1
   AC_MSG_CHECKING([whether to enable unsafe CA bundle search in PATH on Windows])
   AC_ARG_ENABLE(ca-search,
@@ -2251,22 +2252,39 @@ dnl --------------------
 dnl check safe CA search
 dnl --------------------
 
-if test "$curl_cv_native_windows" = "yes"; then
+if test "$curl_cv_native_windows" = "yes" && test "$curl_cv_winuwp" != "yes"; then
+  ca_search_safe=1
   AC_MSG_CHECKING([whether to enable safe CA bundle search (within the curl tool directory) on Windows])
   AC_ARG_ENABLE(ca-search-safe,
-AS_HELP_STRING([--enable-ca-search-safe],[Enable safe CA bundle search])
-AS_HELP_STRING([--disable-ca-search-safe],[Disable safe CA bundle search (default)]),
+AS_HELP_STRING([--enable-ca-search-safe],[Enable safe CA bundle search (default)])
+AS_HELP_STRING([--disable-ca-search-safe],[Disable safe CA bundle search]),
   [ case "$enableval" in
+    no)
+      AC_MSG_RESULT([no])
+      ca_search_safe=0
+      ;;
     yes)
       AC_MSG_RESULT([yes])
-      AC_DEFINE(CURL_CA_SEARCH_SAFE, 1, [If safe CA bundle search is enabled])
       ;;
     *)
-      AC_MSG_RESULT([no])
+      if test "$ca_native_opt" = "1"; then
+        AC_MSG_RESULT([no])
+        ca_search_safe=0
+      else
+        AC_MSG_RESULT([yes])
+      fi
       ;;
     esac ],
-      AC_MSG_RESULT([no])
+      if test "$ca_native_opt" = "1"; then
+        AC_MSG_RESULT([no])
+        ca_search_safe=0
+      else
+        AC_MSG_RESULT([yes])
+      fi
   )
+  if test "$ca_search_safe" = "1"; then
+    AC_DEFINE(CURL_CA_SEARCH_SAFE, 1, [If safe CA bundle search is enabled])
+  fi
 fi
 
 dnl **********************************************************************
